project_type: React SPA with Vite bundler - TV show watchlist tracker
build_system: Vite 4 with tsc for type checking. Scripts: npm run build (tsc && vite build), npm run dev, npm test (vitest run)
test_framework: Vitest with @testing-library/react and @testing-library/user-event. Tests in src/test/ directory, setup file at src/test/setup.ts imports @testing-library/jest-dom
verification_instructions: Run npx tsc --noEmit to type-check. Run npx vitest run to execute tests. Both should pass with zero errors.
setup_instructions: npm install (requires network). Under INTEGRATIONS_ONLY, use npx with globally available tsc for type checking.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot install npm packages. node_modules does not exist. Must validate changes via AST/code review. Global tsc available for type checking but needs node_modules for React types. Verification is limited to code correctness review.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing code patterns: functional components, named exports for components, default export for App.
key_patterns: Components use named exports in src/components/. Types defined in src/types.ts. Storage layer in src/storage.ts. Tests mirror component names in src/test/. Props interfaces defined inline per component. State management via useState/useEffect in App.tsx with prop-drilling. No external state library.
directory_structure: src/ - main source. src/components/ - React components. src/test/ - test files. Root has config files (vite.config.ts, tsconfig.json, package.json).
